title: Cathay Pacific's strong H1 results demonstrate strong jet fuel plans, cost management

Cathay Pacific's strong H1 results demonstrate strong jet fuel plans, cost management
Mayur Patel of OAG Aviation says Cathay Pacific’s strong interim performance highlights how strong network execution and disciplined cost management can deliver results despite ongoing jet-fuel volatility. He points out that fuel hedging cushioned around 50% of the impact of higher fuel costs, with the cargo mix providing an additional buffer.
